items.title: Advanced Airway Support
diagnosis: Assess airway patency, oxygenation, ventilation, mental status, and anticipated difficulty.
management: Optimize oxygenation and ventilation, prepare backup and rescue plans, confirm placement with waveform capnography when available, and reassess continuously.
algorithms: ABCDE → basic maneuvers/non-invasive support → definitive airway when indicated → rescue pathway → post-placement confirmation.
summary: Begin with oxygenation, ventilation, monitoring, suction, backup equipment, and an explicit rescue plan.
Choose the least invasive effective support, escalating from basic maneuvers and noninvasive support to a definitive airway when physiology or clinical course requires it.
Before rapid sequence intubation, optimize physiology, anticipate difficult mask ventilation and rescue, assign team roles, and prepare a surgical-airway pathway.
After placement, confirm tube position with continuous waveform capnography when available, reassess oxygenation and ventilation, and document the plan for sedation and ongoing care.
examPearls: Preparation and rescue planning are part of the procedure, not optional extras.
Repeated attempts increase risk; change the plan early when the first approach fails.
examTraps: Do not treat a tube depth number as confirmation of tracheal placement.
Do not allow a difficult airway plan to delay oxygenation and ventilation.
items.arabicExplanation: الفكرة الأساسية: ابدأ بالأكسجة والتهوية والتحضير الجيد، ثم صعّد التدخل تدريجيًا. قبل التنبيب جهّز خطة إنقاذ واضحة، وبعده تأكد من مكان الأنبوب وأعد تقييم المريض باستمرار.

items.title: Acute Coronary Syndromes
diagnosis: Use focused history, serial ECGs when indicated, biomarkers interpreted in timing context, and assessment for alternative lethal diagnoses.
management: Treat as time-sensitive, escalate unstable or ischemic presentations urgently, and follow the current local antithrombotic and reperfusion pathway.
algorithms: Stability check → ECG/monitoring → serial assessment → reperfusion or risk pathway → reassessment.
summary: Treat suspected acute coronary syndrome as a time-sensitive diagnosis while obtaining a focused history, serial ECGs when indicated, and appropriately timed cardiac biomarkers.
Separate immediate reperfusion decisions from later risk stratification; persistent ischemic changes, instability, or shock require urgent senior and cardiology escalation.
Use bleeding risk, renal function, drug interactions, and the local pathway when selecting antithrombotic therapy; never copy a dose without checking a current protocol.
Reassess for alternative lethal diagnoses such as aortic dissection, pulmonary embolism, and tension pneumothorax when the presentation is atypical or unstable.
examPearls: A single nondiagnostic ECG does not exclude evolving ischemia.
Stability and ECG findings drive urgency before a complete biomarker series is available.
examTraps: Do not anchor on troponin without interpreting timing and clinical context.
Do not administer antithrombotic therapy before considering dissection when its features are present.
items.arabicExplanation: تعامل مع المتلازمة التاجية الحادة كحالة حساسة للوقت. تخطيط القلب المتكرر والسياق السريري مهمان، ويجب التفكير بتشخيصات قاتلة أخرى قبل إعطاء مضادات التخثر أو الصفيحات.

items.title: Respiratory Distress
diagnosis: Integrate work of breathing, mental status, oxygenation, ventilation, examination, and focused bedside testing to identify reversible causes.
management: Treat life threats immediately, provide oxygen or ventilatory support matched to physiology, and escalate early for fatigue or refractory hypoxemia.
algorithms: ABCDE → reversible threat → targeted support → reassess response → escalate when failing.
summary: Use an immediate ABC assessment with work of breathing, mental status, oxygenation, ventilation, and perfusion; treat life threats while diagnosing the cause.
Look for rapidly reversible causes including bronchospasm, pulmonary edema, pneumothorax, upper-airway obstruction, opioid toxicity, and severe infection.
Choose oxygen and ventilatory support according to the physiology and response, with early escalation when fatigue, altered consciousness, or refractory hypoxemia develops.
Reassess after every intervention and use bedside imaging, blood gas interpretation, and focused ultrasound only as components of the clinical picture.
examPearls: A normal oxygen saturation can coexist with dangerous work of breathing or hypercapnia.
The trajectory after treatment is diagnostically informative.
examTraps: Do not delay decompression of suspected tension pneumothorax for imaging.
Do not use a single pulse-oximeter reading to decide that the patient is safe.
items.arabicExplanation: ابدأ بتقييم مجرى الهواء والتنفس والدوران، وعالج الأسباب القابلة للعكس فورًا. راقب جهد التنفس والوعي والاتجاه العام، لأن تحسن أو تدهور المريض بعد التدخل يحمل قيمة تشخيصية.
